data: Gain a Barrier whenever you take significant spirit damage from enemy Heroes in a small time frame.
Your next bullet deals bonus spirit damage.
Launch yourself high into the air and grant yourself a Barrier. While in the air, you can use the active again to drop down faster.
Cannot be used for 5s if attacked by enemy Hero.
Launch an expanding projectile which Silences enemies for a short duration and deals impact damage.
Silence does not interrupt channeling abilities.
Launch a projectile that deals damage, applies a strong slow that recovers over time, prevents Stamina usage and Silences their movement-based items and abilities.
Gain a Barrier whenever you take significant weapon damage from enemy Heroes in a small time frame.
Provide the target with a Barrier and temporary Move Speed.
Cooldown is reduced by half when cast on someone else.
Gain a Barrier when you are Stunned, Chained, Immobilized, Slept or Silenced.
Remove all non-stun debuffs from the target and provide them with a Barrier and Move Speed.
Can be self-cast. Cooldown is reduced by half when cast on someone else.

You enter a void state and become untargetable and invincible for a short duration, during which you float slowly and cannot perform actions. Afterwards you gain Spirit Power, Move Speed, and Spirit Resist.
Target an enemy to reduce their Fire Rate and Bullet Resistance.
Whenever you score an assist or kill, gain extra sprint, ability range and passive soul generation. This effect stacks and persists through death.
When you perform a Light or Heavy Melee attack against a hero, the attack deals extra spirit damage and steals Spirit Resist and Spirit Power.
Effects are reduced by 30% for Light Melee hits.
Teleport straight ahead, gaining Bullet Resist.
After not taking damage for a period, gain health regen.
When you are above 75% health, you have bonus Move Speed.
Dash forward, gaining slow resistance while leaving a flaming trail that deals spirit damage over time.
Hold [W] while active to dash farther.
Enable 2 Ability Charges with 14s Recharge time
Weapon hits build up a burning effect, dealing spirit damage over time.
Abilities refresh to the base burn duration and weapon hits extend it.
Shoot a ball of lightning that travels in a straight line. Does damage to all targets in its radius. Slows down when damaging enemies and stops if it hits the world.
-28% move speed on hit targets and +1s Lifetime
Deploy a spirit that provides healing to nearby allies.
Fire a projectile that swaps your position with the target enemy hero.
200 Barrier for 8s. Barrier scales with Spirit
Swaps all enemies within 7m of hit target and +10% Max Health Damage
While channeling, restore health over time to you and any allies nearby.
You can dash and melee without breaking the channel.
Aura provides +4m Move Speed during channel
Full move and ability use and additionally heals +2.5% of Max Health per second
Target yourself or a Hero to freeze the air and create an impenetrable dome around them. While in the dome, allies gain rapid regeneration and enemies are slowed.
Objectives becomes Invulnerable and Frozen under Frozen Shelter
Purges non-ult debuffs for you and your allies.
+65 Health Regen and increased Spirit Scaling
Throw a cluster of bombs that detonate after a delay, dealing spirit damage.
Enemies hit by multiple bombs take 65% damage.
Per Bomb Touch : -6% Melee Resist for 6s
Turn to shadows and possess Ava. You gain bonus move speed that increases over time, and become hidden on the minimap.
Taking damage from an enemy hero resets your bonus move speed and puts Ava on a brief cooldown.
Gain Damage Amp over time, up to 18%. Lingers for 6s
Curse an enemy hero. If they don't move away from their initial position within the escape time, they will be damaged and immobilized.
Warden deals +20% more Bullet Damage to trapped Heroes for 5s
Silences enemies until they escape or are immobilized
Throw a dagger, dealing spirit damage and applying slow.
Every subsequent dagger against the same target stacks in spirit damage and slow.
On Hit: -8% Bullet Resist and -6% Bullet Resist per Stack
Active: Accentuate your senses, revealing a trail that leads to nearby heroes.
Isolated heroes leave a trail as they move, and emit their heartbeat from afar.
You deal amplified damage against isolated heroes, and when isolated heroes die nearby you gain permanent weapon damage.
+3m/s Move Speed when around an isolated enemy hero
On isolated hero death: Heal 24% of your missing health and restores 2 Stamina
Taking any damage passively charges up your Pain Battery.
Once full, activating the ability fires multiple shocking bolts, dealing spirit damage once per target.
On Hero Hit: Heal for 15% of your missing health and increased Spirit scaling
Unleash pain, dealing spirit damage over time to both enemies and yourself.
The damage continues to increase the longer the ability is channeled, up to a maximum amount.
Enemies receive 20% Move and Dash Slow

Throw out a call bell that deals spirit damage on impact. After a short delay it explodes, dealing additional spirit damage and causing affected enemies to suffer reduced weapon accuracy and movement slow.
Can be shot to detonate early.
Previous recorded cooldown change: 32s to 28s, May 19th, 2025.
Previous recorded cooldown change: 45s to 40s, July 29th, 2025.
